parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.

> Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to query the details of all clusters under your account, including the cluster ID.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
The time granularity of the data to retrieve. Valid values: **60** (minutes) and **3600** (hours).

- If you set **Interval** to **60**, you can query data from the last month. The maximum time range for a single query is 7 days.
- If you set **Interval** to **3600**, you can query data from the last month. The maximum time range for a single query is 7 days.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC.
